name: Ming-Image-0.2-Design
summary: Generate storefront banners or interface mockups with text in the image. Download the MIT-licensed weights, including a compressed version for ComfyUI.

name: Pax
summary: Resume a Claude Code or Codex session in a terminal coding agent that lets you switch models. Install the open-source beta and connect an API key, a ChatGPT subscription, or GitHub Copilot.

name: Kandinsky ImageSR 2.0
summary: Enlarge a small image to twice or four times its original dimensions for a product page or print layout. Try the browser demo on Hugging Face or run the model on an NVIDIA GPU.

name: Install artifacts as apps
summary: Turn a Claude artifact into a desktop app on Mac or Windows with notifications and keyboard shortcuts. The beta is rolling out across Claude plans and requires you to be online and signed in.

name: Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B
summary: Run a coding and tool-using agent on your own machine in about 6 GB, with no cloud calls. The Apache 2.0 weights are on Hugging Face and run via llama.cpp or MLX on Macs, iPhones, and iPads.

name: MAGI-2
summary: Make a video of up to 30 seconds in 1080p with matching sound in one pass, guided by your own images, clips, or audio. Use it now on Higgsfield, where the API runs $0.08 per second.

name: Niji 8
summary: Keep a character recognizable across comic panels by giving the editor a character sheet and a new background. Select Niji 8 in the web app’s Version menu.

name: OCRia-nano-1
summary: Turn scanned PDFs into Markdown with tables intact, right on your laptop with no GPU or API key. It installs through the open-source LiteParse tool and is free for personal use and businesses under $2M in revenue and funding.
